meta.based_on: T-10M (Object 272) fitted with the Oplot-MO anti-missile machine-gun complex
meta.notes: Rebuilt from the general-view drawing of the T-10M with the Oplot-MO (side, plan and front views, gridded at their scales): lofted hull sections and cast turret sections, running gear positions, the M-62-T2 and the Oplot-MO housing as drawn; the coaxial KPVT is removed as the drawing's table lists. The Oplot-MO gun's dip by bearing is from the drawing of its depression limits. Gear ratios are estimates chosen to match the published 50 km/h; the 3BM-11, 3BK-9 and the Oplot-MO's rate of fire are approximate.
